Translated view of NAND; not additional physical capacity.

interpretation: Hierarchy is a capacity/file view, not a physical adjacency map.
Only nodes with explicit range values have a documented contiguous byte range. Aggregate nodes may combine disjoint metadata or padding.
NAND logical offsets cannot be interpreted as physical NAND offsets.
Child sizes sum to the parent, but child ranges may use different address spaces.
No stock free-space figure is established. FF bytes and partition headroom are not classified as usable filesystem space.
Device-capture evidence is not a factory-state measurement.
Package checksums establish consistency, not publisher cryptographic authenticity.

nodes.name: udisk
nodes.description: Writable file storage used for custom apps and other files. The partition reserves 10 MiB; the captured FAT16 format provides 10,426,368 bytes of file-data capacity. Clean-stock free space has not been measured. Installed apps and their usage are excluded from this reference.
nodes.verification: Writable filesystem verified; captured FAT16 format verified; clean-stock free space not measured
nodes.source: Verified device ACPT partition table / stock contents not supplied

evidence.Device capture: The captured reservation contains non-FF bytes. Non-FF byte counts are not a measure of active data. Observed FAT16 format: 512-byte sectors, 1024-byte clusters, two identical FAT copies. 59,392 bytes of format overhead leave 10,426,368 bytes of file-data capacity. These describe the captured format, not verified factory formatting or available space.
evidence.Driver and format: ACPT file ID 40 matches PARTITION_FILE_ID_UDISK in the Actions SDK partition header. Filesystem geometry comes from the captured boot sector and allocation-table equality; installed files and their free-space counts are excluded.
evidence.Verification limits: Factory contents and subsequent use are not documented by this device observation.

nodes.name: NAND management
nodes.description: Capacity managed internally by the flash translation layer: mapping tables, update-log blocks and the block allocation pool.
nodes.verification: Capacity and roles verified; stock allocation unknown
nodes.source: Chip geometry + driver trace + live metadata; no physical content dump

evidence.Driver and format: 1024 physical blocks minus 984 logical blocks = 40 blocks (5 MiB). Physical-page reader and mapping/log/pool handling were traced.
evidence.Device capture: Two live RAM metadata captures accounted for 8 update-log blocks, 31 allocation-pool blocks and 1 zone-table block. Two physical blocks exchanged roles; these counts are observations, not a factory baseline.
evidence.Verification limits: Raw physical contents, full OOB, per-block health and factory role assignments remain unverified. Pool membership does not imply erased pages.
